column1: web-designer-at-aios-remote-75k-150k-yr-including-equity-berlin-388201,AIOS (YC W20/S21),"Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)",Remote (EU),False,1794120011,"About AIOSAIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving &gt
column2: 200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.Our master plan:Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOSBeing a Web Designer at AIOSWe’re building a world-class team.As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)Key responsibilitiesYou’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.Need to haveExperience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.Nice to haveCRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.Our cultural standardsWe aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves &amp
column3: our team-members:Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.If we're average we fail: We are only interested in ""insanely great"", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely &amp
column4: carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.🎯""You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take.""Compensation &amp

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.

You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.

You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.
Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.&nbsp
Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.

Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform
Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

column1: research-staff-voice-ai-foundations-uk-remote-london-419387,Deepgram,"Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations [UK - Remote]","London, UK",False,1794120011,"Company OverviewDeepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.   Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.The ChallengeWe are seeking researchers who:See ""unsolved"" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approachesCan identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not monthsHave the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100xAre obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impactIf you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. column5: Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.1. Statistical &amp
column6: Mathematical FoundationsMastery of Core ConceptsMany papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.Combining Existing Theories in Novel WaysPapers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.Logical Reasoning and Assumption TestingAcross all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., ""scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness"" or ""straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency"") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.2. Algorithmic Innovation &amp
column7: ImplementationCreative Solutions to Known BottlenecksEach paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.Turning Theory into PracticeWhether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.Clear Impact Through Prototypes &amp
column8: Open-SourceMany references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.3. Data-Driven &amp
column9: Scalable SystemsEmphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient PipelinesPapers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., ""data optimal regime"") can yield high performance even in smaller models.Strategic Use of Data for Staged TrainingA recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.4. Hardware &amp
column10: Systems UnderstandingEfficient Implementations at ScaleMany works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.Real-Time &amp
column11: On-Device ConstraintsSoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.Architectural &amp
column12: Optimization DetailsPapers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.5. Rigorous Experimental DesignControlled Comparisons &amp
column13: AblationsNearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.Multifold Evaluation MetricsFrom MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.Stress Tests &amp
column14: Edge CasesWhisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. column1: research-staff-voice-ai-foundations-remote-amsterdam-428068,Deepgram,"Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations - Remote",The Netherlands,False,1794120012,"Company OverviewDeepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.The RoleAs a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.   Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.The ChallengeWe are seeking researchers who:See ""unsolved"" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approachesCan identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not monthsHave the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100xAre obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impactIf you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. column5: Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.1. Statistical &amp
column6: Mathematical FoundationsMastery of Core ConceptsMany papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). column1: forward-deployed-engineer-finance-utrecht-123469,adesso Netherlands,Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance,"Utrecht, Utrecht, Nederland",False,1794033086,"Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk.Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Dat systeem is over honderden jaren opgebouwd en ingericht op een gematigd klimaat. Met zeespiegelstijging, droogte en zware neerslag lopen we nu tegen de grenzen aan. Drinkwaterbedrijven luiden de noodklok over leveringszekerheid en piekbuien wisselen af met extreme droogte. Water is bepalend voor waar we kunnen bouwen, werken en leven. Om weerbaar te worden moeten we andere keuzes maken over de inrichting en het gebruik van onze leefomgeving, waarbij functies beter aansluiten op de draagkracht van het water- en bodemsysteem.Elke dag worden er nieuwe ruimtelijke keuzes gemaakt, bijvoorbeeld over woningbouw, bedrijfsuitbreiding of het energiesysteem. Om daarin meer rekening te houden met water en bodem moeten de wereld van water en bodem en de wereld van ruimtelijke ordening beter samenwerken en elkaars taal leren spreken. Daarvoor bestaan al instrumenten, methoden en werkwijzen, zoals Omgevingstafels, de Watertoets, blauwe omgevingsvisies en water- en bodemsysteemanalyses. Maar werken die instrumenten ook echt, en wat is er nodig om ze beter te laten aansluiten op de praktijk? Dat zoeken wij uit.Wil jij aan het begin van jouw loopbaan direct meewerken aan onderzoek dat bijdraagt aan de koers van Nederland? Bij Berenschot werk je in een dynamisch team van adviseurs op het gebied van water en ruimte. Je krijgt de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen én tegelijkertijd maatschappelijke impact te maken.Dit ga je doenJouw onderzoek:Je maakt een inventarisatie van bestaande en nieuwe, innovatieve instrumenten en methoden, en/of je formuleert succesfactoren voor één specifiek instrument (een best practice). Samen met jou en je begeleiders bepalen we de precieze afbakening.Je onderzoek is onderdeel van het project Kwartiermaker water- en bodemsysteemanalyses (Interprovinciaal Overleg en het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat). Mogelijke resultaten zijn een bijdrage aan de analyse en toolbox van het kwartiermakerschap, een publicatie over best practices, of een instrumentenkoffer voor waterschappen, provincies en het ministerie van IenW.Je bent daarmee onderdeel van het kwartiermakerverhaal, maar blijft niet bij één project. Voor je onderzoek kun je ook putten uit andere lopende trajecten van ons team, zoals het Deltaprogramma Ruimtelijke Adaptatie (DPRA). Daar spelen vergelijkbare vragen over hoe je samenwerking tussen overheden en regio’s echt werkend krijgt. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.Dit zijn je directe collega’sJe maakt deel uit van het team Duurzame Leefomgeving

Alternatively, you have 2–4+ years of experience at a specialised financial services consultancy, working on IT infrastructure-related projects, ideally within the investment services sectorClosing track record: You have successfully taken complex commercial or partnership deals from initial discussions through to signature and launch, ideally with a track record of consistent quota attainment. You are seeking an individual contributor role and are genuinely motivated by selling and closing deals rather than managing a sales teamIndustry Exposure: You have previous experience in financial services, with a strong interest in software- and infrastructure-as-a-service products (e.g., BaaS and embedded payments), and a genuine curiosity about investments and securities tradingClient-centric sales: You have demonstrated expertise with B2B sales methodologies, such as solution/consultative selling as well as practical application of industry best practices, always starting with the clients needs'Modern, AI-enabled selling: You work data- and KPI-driven, apply clear qualification frameworks to allocate your time, and use AI actively to increase your coverage and throughputStakeholder management Skills: You have demonstrated strong leadership skills, are able to communicate well with different stakeholder groups, from product and growth teams to legal, risk and compliance, and are not afraid to challenge assumptions internally or externally.Negotiation Skills: Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with the ability to create trust, effectively handle objections and present compelling pitches.Project Management: Hands-on, proactive ownership of complex projects, including ensuring consistent and reliable communication with multiple client and internal stakeholders and diligent internal documentation.It’s great if you also have:Experience selling to banks or wealth managersIndustry Knowledge - thorough understanding of the investment industry, its current trends and competitive landscapeProfessional Network: Strong professional network in the investment industryLocation Preference: Preference for candidates located in Berlin / remote Germany and fluent in German (C2 or native)How we Upvest in you:Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the marketImpact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. No legacy systems, no limitsWellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. column1: recruiter-commercial-berlin-258857,Andercore,"Recruiter, Commercial",Berlin,False,1794076813,"About AndercoreAndercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. column3: Automation Intern to help build the software behind our robotic test and automation infrastructure. column3: As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems.&amp

Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.Your future teamYou will be part of the Paid Search team, the growth engine of Holidu's Performance Marketing: we run Google Ads and Microsoft Ads across all Holidu domains and brands in Europe, on both sides of the marketplace - Guest (B2C, bookings) and Host (B2B, lead generation). We are a small, international and highly analytical team: value-based bidding at scale, our own bidding infrastructure, and data-driven in every decision. We work AI-first, and we are early: as marketers, we build our own analyses, automations and internal apps with LLM tooling (mainly Claude), together with our MarTech team. The team is led by Andreas, who has two decades of experience in digital marketing, and you will work closely with Rasmus, one of Holidu's Co-Founders.What you will doThis role suits a proactive builder: strong numerical mindset, comfortable creating structure where none exists yet, at home in both strategy and hands-on execution.Own large-scale Search Engine Advertising across multiple European markets (Google Ads and Microsoft Ads), from account structure to value-based bidding that grows efficientlyChallenge how we do paid search today: question our bidding logic, structures and processes, and bring perspectives we have not considered. With us, arguments and data weigh more than job titlesCo-build internal marketing apps with Claude Code and GitHub, as a marketer, not an engineer. We are first movers here: you will learn a skill almost nobody in the market has yet, and you will shape our tooling together with our MarTech teamOwn your numbers end-to-end: find the improvement potential others walk past, run high-impact A/B tests across large budgets, decide with data, and turn results into playbooks instead of one-off learningsPilot what is next in paid search: AI Max, the first generation of LLM advertising (OpenAI/ChatGPT Ads), and AI-powered workflows from anomaly detection to statistical analysisWhat you bringA sharp, quantitative mindset and strong analytical thinking: you make decisions with data, spot what others miss, and can argue your case clearlyOwnership of business results: you think in outcomes, not processes, and build solutions rather than wait for instructionsHands-on experience in paid search (Google Ads
column2: Microsoft Ads as a plus): trajectory and depth of thinking matter more to us than yearsGenuine curiosity about AI in marketing: you’ve already used AI tools to change how you work, not just to draft texts, and want to go deeper. No engineering background needed, curiosity is the requirementFluent English (our working language)
column3: any additional language is a plusWhat we offerImpact: Make a difference for hundreds of thousands of monthly users.Growth: Take responsibility from day one and develop through regular feedback, workshops, and knowledge exchanges.Personal Development: Use your learning budget and 2 extra study days for conferences, books, courses, and more.Community: Engage with international, diverse, yet like-minded colleagues through regular events and 2 office days per week with your team.Flexibility: Benefit from our hybrid work policy and the chance to work from other local offices for up to 8 weeks a year.Fitness: Get a premium gym membership at a discounted rate.Travel: Enjoy 28 vacation days + 13 public holidays in Bavaria and the possibility to take up to 10 unpaid vacation days with special discounts on our Holidu Homes properties.Life at HoliduCheck out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram Apply now!We champion diversity in every aspect of life. We encourage applications from all genders, corners of the world and individual backgrounds. column3: Huntress is looking for a Senior Channel Marketing Manager to plan and execute channel marketing across EMEA, working with both distributors and resellers. Plan and execute regional marketing programs with EMEA distributors and resellers, including demand generation campaigns, webinars, events, and product launch activity.&lt

Manage day-to-day marketing relationships with distributor partners and resellers, including joint plans, campaign calendars, and regular performance reviews.&lt

Track and report on regional channel marketing KPIs, including partner engagement, pipeline, campaign conversion, and fund utilization.&lt
Identify what distributors and resellers need to market Huntress successfully and bring those insights back to the Channel Programs team.&lt
Support regional partner events, distributor business reviews, and partner communications.&lt
Ensure consistent follow-up on all channel-generated leads, with accurate lead capture, tracking, and prompt routing to the appropriate internal owner for next steps.&lt

column1: centrale-lyon-post-doctoral-open-and-flexible-system-level-evaluation-framework-for-emerging-ai-computing-architectures-ecully-279744,CENTRALE LYON,CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures,"Ecully, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, France",False,1794033081,"Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit. The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible. The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability. A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning. Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths

column3: Our Production Quality team in Thessaloniki is the technical shield protecting the integrity of STARK’s next-generation autonomous systems. We value absolute technical precision, structured problem-solving, and the proactive ownership required to safeguard zero-defect manufacturing standards.&lt

As our Quality Assurance Inspector, you will be the final gatekeeper of production standards on our assembly floor. Utilizing your combined knowledge of mechanical and electronics engineering, you will continuously review active assembly lines, verify build documentation, and ensure all mandatory inline steps are executed flawlessly. You will take end-to-end ownership of on-floor quality checks—collaborating closely with Manufacturing Engineers to identify assembly gaps, block defective parts, and update localized Control Plans so our processes are continuously improved.&lt

column5: WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK&lt

column3: Conduct rigorous inline quality checks on active production lines, verifying that electro-mechanical sub-assemblies, wire harnesses, and avionics conform exactly to design schematics.&lt
Review assembly lines to identify physical gaps, actively collaborating with Manufacturing Engineers to implement tooling, jig, or process improvements.&lt
Define, update, and maintain dynamic Control Plans (CPs) for inline assemblies and final products based on real-time assembly data.&lt
Block defective products immediately, physically isolating and managing quarantined materials on the floor.&lt
Initiate and coordinate technical reworks, providing on-floor guidance to technicians and verifying that repaired systems meet original engineering standards before re-release.&lt
Perform final quality checks and outgoing document reviews before delivery, recording deviations in the QMS and creating precise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).&lt

column5: WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION&lt

column3: Education: Vocational diploma or technical degree in mechatronics, electronics, mechanical assembly, or a related field.&lt
Experience: 3+ years as a Quality Inspector, QA Specialist, or Lead Assembler in aerospace, automotive, or defense.&lt
Technical Skills: Strong practical understanding of both electronics (wiring, connectors) and mechanics (tolerances, fasteners, blueprints).&lt

column5: Control Plans: Proven ability to spot floor assembly gaps, collaborate with Manufacturing Engineers, and execute dynamic Control Plans (CPs).&lt
Languages: Experience managing non-conformances in QMS/ERP with professional working proficiency in English and Greek.&lt

column3: Active certifications in IPC-A-610 and IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards.&lt
Familiarity with flight-critical avionics systems (flight controllers, power distribution boards, telemetry) or military-grade hardware, tactical defense systems, and UAS.&lt
Familiarity with ERP/QMS platforms (SAP QM, JIRA, CAQ) and basic training in Lean manufacturing, Kaizen, or Six Sigma.&lt

column1: scriptwriter-intern-paris-146650,Finary,Scriptwriter intern,Paris,False,1794022830,"La mission de FinaryNotre mission : rendre le pouvoir aux investisseurs. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenairesComprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.2. Animer le business Resell et CosellCréer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateursIdentifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomesMaîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relationAssurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie PartnershipsCoordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires. Profil recherché :Compétences incontournables :Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs

Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenairesComprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.2. Animer le business Resell et CosellCréer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateursIdentifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomesMaîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relationAssurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.6. d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours🚀 Déjà plus de 1,000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Le posteNous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support Financial Services N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 Financial Services pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Financial Services Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne au quotidien les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable. Elle intègre également un Compte Pro, qui permet aux entrepreneurs et aux PME de gérer leurs opérations bancaires courantes : cartes, virements, encaissements, dépôts de capitaux, financements…L’équipe Support Financial Services N2 traite les demandes les plus complexes, qui nécessitent une expertise approfondie des produits bancaires et de la plateforme. Elle travaille en lien avec les équipes du Support Niveau 1 externalisé, du Support Technique, du Produit, de la Tech et des Ops, ainsi qu’avec nos partenaires bancaires.Ce poste est centré sur le management de proximité. Tu seras le relais opérationnel du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services et accompagneras au quotidien une équipe de 6 à 12 agents pour leur permettre d’apporter aux utilisateurs des réponses efficaces, de qualité et empreintes d’empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité et à l’amélioration continue du support. Tu pourras intervenir ponctuellement sur des projets transverses, en apportant la vision terrain de l’équipe.Notre cultureAu sein du Costumer Support de Pennylane, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience.Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust.Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à çaAnimer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations et donner un feedback constructif.Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité, notamment le temps de première réponse, le temps intermédiaire de réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume traité.Participer aux rituels de pilotage : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.Remonter les irritants liés aux produits bancaires, aux processus ou aux délais de réponse des partenaires externes.Contribuer à l’amélioration des process, de la documentation et des outils internes.ResponsabilitésManager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services, en les accompagnant dans leur activité, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.Accompagner individuellement les collaborateurs qui ont besoin de soutien sur la qualité de leurs réponses ou l’efficacité du traitement des demandes : analyser les situations, donner des feedbacks concrets, proposer un coaching ou une formation adaptée et suivre les progrès.Etre garant des indicateurs de performance de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, tout en veillant à la bonne prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et au suivi des demandes en cours.Contribuer à l’organisation de l’équipe : préparer et ajuster le planning, anticiper les absences et organiser la couverture des files et des permanences, en veillant à une répartition équilibrée de la charge. Faire remonter au Senior Team Lead les besoins de renfort ou les arbitrages nécessaires.Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes urgentes ou complexes concernant le Compte Pro, les cartes, les virements, les encaissements ou les dépôts de capitaux, et orienter ou escalader lorsque nécessaire.Collaborer étroitement avec les autres managers de proximité de l’équipe pour partager les pratiques, coordonner les priorités et assurer une continuité managériale cohérente.Faire le lien avec le Support Technique, les équipes Produit, Tech et Ops, ainsi qu’avec les BPO qui traitent le Support Niveau 1, afin de partager les priorités, faire remonter les irritants et faciliter les escalades et la continuité de prise en charge.Collaborer avec les partenaires bancaires, notamment Swan.Identifier et proposer des améliorations des process, des outils, de la documentation et des modes de fonctionnement du Support, puis contribuer à leur mise en œuvre selon les priorités définies.Mettre en place des plans d'action sur l'activité, en cas de besoin.Ce poste est fait pour toi siTu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même lorsque les sujets sont complexes ou impliquent plusieurs parties prenantes.Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support Financial Services dans un environnement en forte évolution.QualificationsDiplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en banque, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.Expérience préalable de minimum 2 ans au sein d'une équipe Support et expérience d’au moins 4 ans en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe.Bonne capacité d’analyse, de prise de décision et de résolution de problèmes.Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.Aisance avec les outils de ticketing et de documentation, notamment Intercom ou Notion.Anglais professionnel, niveau B2 minimum, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, afin de pouvoir collaborer avec des interlocuteurs anglophones et piloter des équipes multilingues.Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement column1: partner-account-manager-cabinet-integrateurs-en-teletravail-depuis-lyon-h-f-322271,Pennylane SAS,"Partner Account Manager, Cabinet Intégrateurs (en télétravail depuis Lyon) (H/F)",Lyon,False,1794012011,"Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre visionNotre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de PennylanePennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenairesComprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.2. Animer le business Resell et CosellCréer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateursIdentifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomesMaîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relationAssurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie PartnershipsCoordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires. Profil recherché :Compétences incontournables :Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs

column1: Prior to applying, please be aware that the final stage of our recruitment process is an in-person interview in New Zealand (click apply and see our application questions for more details).

At Propellerhead, the Technical Strategist role focuses on the delivery of resilient software systems that power everything from complex infrastructure to innovative new platforms. This role works alongside our Product Strategists to shape the technical specification and platform direction for a portfolio of client products.

We’re looking for someone who combines architectural insight with a strong hands-on engineering background and a genuinely AI-native way of working. You will have spent the formative part of your career as a software developer and still be confident with understanding the structure of software solutions. You'll have knowledge of emerging trends and you are agentic-first where you reach for AI to rapidly prototype new ideas and judge their value in hours, not weeks, and you are at home with directing an AI-assisted delivery pipeline.

You will lead and guide the design of complex systems, and we'll depend on your extensive experience, judgement and insights to ensure that early delivery and continuous improvement is possible. You’ll be applying and reinforcing Engineering standards for programming, and shape the technical solutions our AI-assisted pipeline builds, in a lean and evolutionary manner. Importantly, you will be responsible for ensuring that client platforms align with our technical strategy. You will work closely with the Chief Technologist and Engineering Principal to apply standards, patterns, and tooling in client contexts, and provide informed input into technical strategy through client platform insights and delivery experience.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.
We offer a culture built on trust, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. You'll join a team that values integrity over ego, and clarity over complexity.
If you're looking to contribute your insight and engineering experience to projects that matter - we would like to hear from you.
8+ years of experience with the development of multi-tier and distributed applications.&nbsp

Agentic-first: very comfortable using AI to rapidly prototype, shape solutions, and direct an AI-assisted delivery pipeline across requirements, testing and code generation. This is central to the role.
A confident, credible communicator and presenter in front of senior client stakeholders.

Our current technologies include React user interfaces, with services written in C#, so previous experience with both is essential. However we also have Typescript, Java, Go and Rust services, so you will need to show confidence in working with a variety of programming languages.

Strong communication skills must be demonstrable, with tangible examples of your skills to bridge technical solutions with business needs and present these concepts to a variety of internal and customer stakeholders.&nbsp
Hands-on experience with designing solutions on Azure is essential, including active participation in building CI/CD pipelines and instrumenting for operations, is required.
Experience with streaming and messaging platforms, such as Kafka or NATS, is highly desirable.
Proven experience in leading the design of complex software applications, preferably for corporate enterprise, where solutions comprise existing services alongside custom development.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You will represent Propellerhead in front of stakeholders, so a professional, confident presence and the ability to communicate and influence with clarity are essential.

We are particularly looking for technical leaders with experience or demonstrable interest in any of the following: digital identity, verifiable credentials, open banking, AI agent authorization, edge or device-based software deployment.
Authoring, reviewing and communicating solution architecture and specifications in collaboration with the Development teams and our core Engineering team.
