marketing-manager-berlin-108791,Cell Labs,Marketing Manager (m/w/d),Berlin,False,1793988044,"Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin.Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch.Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden.Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung: VollzeitDeine AufgabenMarketingstrategie & Umsetzung: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Gründer:in und dem restlichen Kreativteam die Markenstrategie von Cell Labs weiter und gestaltest u. a. den bevorstehenden Produktlaunch aktiv mit, von Messaging über Kampagnen bis zu Events.Digital Marketing & Performance: Du entwickelst unsere digitale Sichtbarkeit weiter, optimierst Website, SEO und SEA und setzt zielgerichtete Kampagnen auf. Dabei testest du neue Ansätze und verbesserst kontinuierlich ihre Wirkung.Content & Kommunikation: Du übersetzt komplexe Robotik-Technologien in verständliche und überzeugende Inhalte für unsere Website, Social Media, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle. Dafür arbeitest du eng mit unseren Gründern, dem Brand- und Designteam sowie den Engineers zusammen.Go-to-Market: Du planst und steuerst Marketingkampagnen entlang des gesamten Funnels, entwickelst Maßnahmen zur B2B-Leadgenerierung und machst Cell Labs bei relevanten Industrieunternehmen und Partnern sichtbar.Events & Kooperationen: Du planst und begleitest relevante Messen, Konferenzen und Partneraktivitäten – von der Vorbereitung der Marketingmaterialien über die Kommunikation bis zur Nachbereitung.Marketing Operations & Analytics: Du definierst, misst und berichtest die Kennzahlen, die zählen: Pipeline-Beitrag, Conversion, Cost per Lead und Funnel-Entwicklung. Daraus leitest du Entscheidungen ab, statt nur Reports zu verwalten.Sales Enablement: In enger Abstimmung mit unseren Gründern unterstützt du Vertrieb und Business Development mit Pitch-Materialien, Use Cases, Case Studies und Produktkommunikation für konkrete Verkaufssituationen.Was du mitbringstErfahrung: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Marketing, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld eines Startups, Scale-ups oder Technologieunternehmens. Du hast Kampagnen eigenständig umgesetzt und idealerweise bereits einen Produktlaunch begleitet.Breites Marketing-Know-how: Du kennst dich mit digitalen Marketingkanälen aus und hast praktische Erfahrung mit SEO, SEA, Content Marketing und Kampagnenmanagement. Du musst nicht alles perfekt beherrschen, weißt aber, wie du die richtigen Maßnahmen priorisierst und umsetzt.Zahlenverständnis: Du setzt dir messbare Ziele und weißt, wie du sie nachhältst. Google Analytics, CRM-Software und Performance-Kennzahlen gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du nutzt Daten, um Marketingmaßnahmen kontinuierlich zu verbessern.Interesse für Technologie: Du interessierst dich für komplexe Technologien und hast Lust, tief in die Robotik einzutauchen. Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verstehen und so vermitteln, dass sie auch für Menschen außerhalb der Entwicklung greifbar werden.Kommunikation & Content: Aus einem technischen Gespräch mit einem Engineer machst du eine Case Study, Website-Copy oder einen Social-Media-Beitrag, der die richtige Zielgruppe erreicht.Arbeitsweise: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, arbeitest eigenständig und pragmatisch und hast Freude daran, neue Strukturen mit aufzubauen. Du wechselst zwischen Planung und Umsetzung, ohne eines von beidem aus dem Blick zu verlieren.Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.BenefitsMarketing von Grund auf: Es gibt kein fertiges Playbook und keine Altlasten. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit unserem Marketingteam, wie Cell Labs am Markt sichtbar wird, und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit direkt.Alles unter einem Dach: Büro, Werkstatt und Teststände liegen im selben Gebäude in Kreuzberg. Wenn du eine Story für eine Case Study brauchst oder den Roboter in Aktion sehen willst, ist der Engineer ein paar Schritte entfernt, kein Ticket.Room to Fail & Grow: Bezahlte Lernzeit mit persönlichem Budget für Kurse, Marketing-Konferenzen und die Tools, die du brauchst. Du bekommst Raum, Neues auszuprobieren, und bringst ein Produkt an den Markt, das bisher kaum jemand gesehen hat.Benefits: Ein Leistungspaket, das du dir selbst zusammenstellst und das Mobilität, Gesundheit, Ernährung oder Fitness abdeckt. Dazu gibt’s einen zusätzlichen bezahlten freien Tag im Jahr für ehrenamtliches Engagement oder ein Projekt, das dir am Herzen liegt.BewerbungSchick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu einer Marketingkampagne oder einem Projekt, das du eigenständig umgesetzt hast. Was war das Ziel, was hast du getan und was kam dabei heraus? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.Der Prozess: Intro Call, Deep Dive in deine bisherige Arbeit, Besuch bei uns mit einer kleinen Case Study, Angebot.Wir bauen Roboter für alle, deshalb wollen wir ein Team, das das abbildet. Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten ein und freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die in Marketing und Tech unterrepräsentiert sind. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, aber denkst, das ist dein Job: bewirb dich.Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow",['git'],1

Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention.

Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment.

column1: internship-explainable-ai-for-the-qualification-of-aerospace-algorithms-amsterdam-236616,Koninklijk Nederlands Lucht- en Ruimtevaartcentrum,Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms,"Amsterdam, Noord-Holland, Nederland",False,1793709101,"BackgroundMachine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.AssignmentThe assignment will include the following tasks:A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which explanations themselves are evaluated.A use case provided by NLR, for instance automated defect detection, and identification of the substantiation needed to qualify the algorithm, translated into criteria that explanations should meet.Implementing several explainability methods for the use case and analysing them against these criteria, for example their faithfulness to the model, their robustness and their usefulness to domain experts.Assessing how the resulting explanations can serve as evidence in the qualification of the algorithm, and formulating recommendations for the use of explainability in qualification.ResultsThe final outcomes of this assignment will be:§&nbsp

column1: product-engineering-lead-munich-375629,Secfix,Product Engineering Lead,Remote - Munich,False,1793979618,"Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zoneHi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. column1: Chez Green-Got, le Customer Care est la voix de nos membres en interne, et la voix de Green-Got auprès d'eux, un rôle stratégique dans une institution financière qui grandit vite et qui doit tenir ses promesses 7 jours sur 7.

Nos membres ont changé de dimension avec nous : Compte Premium, PER, compte commun, offre indépendant. Chaque nouveau produit génère de nouvelles questions, de nouvelles situations, de nouveaux défis. L'ouverture prochaine des services BtoB va encore élargir le périmètre.
Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui aime comprendre, qui sait garder son calme sous pression, et qui considère chaque échange comme une opportunité d'améliorer le produit, pas juste de fermer un ticket.
Tu es à l'aise avec les gens et rigoureux sur le fond. Les deux à la fois.

Membre de l'équipe Customer Care, tu es le point de relais central entre nos membres et toutes les équipes de Green-Got : produit, tech, compliance, marketing, impact. Ton périmètre est vivant : il évolue avec nos lancements, nos besoins, et la trajectoire de Green-Got.
Ta capacité à t'adapter, à prioriser et à garder un haut niveau de qualité dans tous les contextes est ce qui nous permettra de grandir sereinement.
Premier point de contact : tu réponds à nos membres sur tous nos canaux, chat (90 %), email (8 %), téléphone (2 %), avec clarté, empathie et dans les délais.
Expertise produit : tu connais Green-Got sur le bout des doigts. Tu accompagnes nos membres sur leurs comptes, leurs transactions, leurs questions, et tu trouves la bonne réponse après investigation.
Gestion des nouvelles situations : tu identifies, qualifies et résous les cas inédits. Tu es garant de la qualité du premier contact.
Voix des membres en interne : tu collectes, structures et remontes les besoins, frustrations et suggestions aux équipes produit, tech, marketing.
Amélioration continue : tu optimises les process existants, challenges les workflows, et maintiens notre documentation (FAQ, process) à jour à chaque évolution produit.
Suivi des incidents : tu identifies les bugs, les remontes aux équipes concernées et en assures le suivi jusqu'à résolution.
Recette fonctionnelle : tu participes aux phases de test des nouvelles fonctionnalités avant mise en production.
Initiative et ownership : tu identifies des leviers d'amélioration de l'expérience membre, tu définis des indicateurs, proposes et mets en œuvre des actions concrètes.
Pilotage : tu mets en place les outils et routines nécessaires au suivi de tes projets et en garantis le résultat.

L'empathie, la rigueur dans l'exécution et la capacité à rester serein quand ça s'accélère sont pour toi des réflexes naturels. Tu comprends que la qualité du service est un engagement, pas une intention. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui en est convaincu.
Chez Green-Got, nous sommes curieux, exigeants, collectifs, et nous allons vite.
Sens du service : tu sais que derrière chaque ticket, il y a une personne. Tu ne fermes pas un ticket, tu résous un problème.
Rigueur et organisation : tu priorises, tu documentes, tu assures un suivi sans failles.
Aisance rédactionnelle : ton orthographe est irréprochable, tu adaptes le ton à chaque interlocuteur. La précision est ta signature.
Curiosité analytique : tu aimes comprendre pourquoi une situation se produit, pas juste la résoudre. Tu identifies les patterns et tu les remontes.
Gestion du stress : tu gardes ton calme quand la situation l'exige. La pression ne dégrade pas ta qualité.
Anglais opérationnel : tu lis, tu réponds, tu échanges sans chercher tes mots. Nous avons des membres non francophones et nous en aurons davantage.
Sensibilité à l'impact : la transition environnementale a une réelle importance pour toi. Tu comprends les enjeux et tu portes la mission de Green-Got avec sincérité.
Appétence pour les outils numériques : Intercom, Notion, Slack, Aircall, et une vraie curiosité pour l'IA et l'automatisation appliquées au service client.
Formation : BTS, IUT, école de commerce, IAE ou toute formation en lien avec la relation client. Une première expérience en care ou service client est un vrai plus.
Green-Got entre dans une nouvelle phase. Avec l'agrément ACPR, nous construisons une expérience membre de premier plan, avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant.
Le service client de demain ne se construit uniquement avec des scripts et des macros. Il se construit avec des personnes qui comprennent le produit, les membres, et l'enjeu de chaque interaction.
Un rôle avec de l'impact réel : dans un secteur en pleine transformation, au contact direct de nos membres chaque jour.
De vraies responsabilités : tu n'exécutes pas, tu contribues. Tes remontées terrain façonnent le produit.
Apprentissage : aux côtés d'une équipe qui transmet, dans un environnement réglementaire de premier plan.
Évolution : les profils les plus engagés grandissent avec nous et prennent des responsabilités clés.
Flexibilité : remote possible depuis chez toi et partout en Europe.
Équipe : ambitieuse, exigeante, déterminée, et qui passe de bons moments ensemble.
Une journée d’équipe tous les semestres.
Envoie-nous ton CV et tout autre élément qui nous aide à jauger tes compétences et ta motivation.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!🦾 Our Offer Operations teamJoko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast.Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons, card-linked bank integrations, gift cards, and merchant performance. It's a technical, data-heavy, high-stakes scope that sits right at the heart of what makes Joko's product work.🎯 What you will doAs an Operations Manager, your main mission is to own one of the processes that decides whether millions of Joko users actually get the cashback they're owed. You'll report to David Le Pahun, our Offer Operations Lead. The role blends four things: analysing data, designing how the process should work, solving problems with AI, technologies or in the last resort outsourcing, and managing projects.Analyse data. You'll build the dashboards that tell you — and everyone else — whether your part of the system is healthy: how many transactions are being correctly tracked and rewarded, what's silently breaking down, whether user experience is suffering.Design the process. You decide how merchants get set up on our platform: their cashback rate, which purchases qualify, how we connect to their systems. A lot of this doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing a good chunk of it as you go.Solve problems with technology. A merchant might be showing users a coupon that doesn't actually pay out. A batch of card purchases might not match cleanly to any merchant we track. You'll dig into why, then fix it choosing the right solution for it: automating it with AI, improving one of our internal tools (built on Retool) and if a human is required, you'll build the right playbook to outsource it.Manage outsourced resources. You'll manage the outsourced team members who help you operate at scale — briefing them, training them, checking their work is actually good — while juggling several of these issues at once and deciding what matters most.Partner cross-functionally. With Product &amp

senior-ux-designer-map-visualisation-amsterdam-the-netherlands-97864,Tomtom,Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation,"Amsterdam, The Netherlands",False,1793590049,"

TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio.&nbsp

You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy.&nbsp

This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft.&nbsp

AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself.&nbsp

Design Compelling Map Experiences Create and refine 2D and 3D map visualisations from concept through production delivery. Own the end-to-end cartographic design process - from data exploration and sketching through to style implementation, QA and iteration across zoom levels, regions and use cases.&nbsp

Maintain and Evolve Core Map Styles Enhance TomTom's core map styles, ensuring consistency, readability and visual quality across platforms, screen densities and global markets. Balance aesthetic ambition with rendering performance and data constraints.&nbsp

Work as Part of the Product Team Work day-to-day alongside software engineers and product managers building TomTom's map data structures, renderers and SDKs. Take part in planning, refinement and reviews, provide design specifications engineers can act on, and review visual output during development and before release.&nbsp

Make and Own Trade-offs Help decide what ships, when and at what quality. Weigh visual fidelity against render budget, memory and frame rate on automotive and mobile hardware, customer requests against platform consistency, and scope against release dates. Reach a decision with the people who own the product, record it and see it through.&nbsp

Contribute to Renderer and Tooling Requirements Provide detailed input on the data and rendering capabilities needed to achieve design goals. Define requirements for internal cartographic authoring tools and identify workflow improvements that raise the team's output quality and speed.&nbsp

Bring AI into the Design Workflow Use AI to shorten the loop from idea to rendered map: generating and editing style-spec JSON, scripting data exploration, and building interactive prototypes on real data instead of static frames. Turn what works into shared workflows the team can reuse, and help define how we check AI-generated output for cartographic quality.&nbsp

Design for AI-Driven Map Experiences Contribute to how the map responds when the request comes from an AI system rather than a tap, for example in GeoAI answers, conversational search or agent-generated routes. Work out how the map shows what the AI found, how confident it is and when it is wrong.&nbsp

Inform Decisions with Research and Data Participate in user research, customer conversations and competitive benchmarking. Use insights to ground design decisions and advocate for improvements that address real user needs.&nbsp

Support the Design System and Standards Contribute to the Map Visualisation design system - documenting patterns, conventions and cartographic guidelines that enable consistency and scale across the product portfolio.&nbsp
A track record of shaping product direction from the design seat. You set out the options, make the case for one and bring engineering, product and business stakeholders with you.&nbsp

A track record of shipping software as a designer embedded in a product team, ideally on map, location or developer-platform products: SDKs, APIs, map styles or tooling that other teams and companies build on.&nbsp

A clear understanding of how products move from discovery to release and beyond, including planning, roadmaps and measuring results after launch. You know how versioned releases, deprecations and backwards compatibility shape design choices on a platform with external customers.&nbsp

Hands-on familiarity with how software gets built: backlogs, refinement, estimation, definition of done, Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD, feature flags and release trains. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand how your designs move through a rendering pipeline and into a release.&nbsp
Sound judgement under constraint. You can point to decisions where you gave something up to ship, and explain why it was right for the product and its users.&nbsp
Clarity with senior audiences. You can turn a complex design problem into a short, well-argued recommendation and own the result.&nbsp
Comfort with disagreement. You challenge a decision with evidence, accept the outcome when it goes the other way and keep the work moving.&nbsp
Experience contributing to solution design documents, technical specifications and cross-functional planning.&nbsp

A solid foundation in digital cartography, GIS or geographic information design. If your map-making depth is still growing, show us how fast you are closing the gap, including how you use AI to learn.&nbsp
Experience designing multi-zoom digital maps with attention to cartographic conventions, label placement, generalisation and cultural adaptation.&nbsp
Working proficiency with key mapping technologies and ecosystems: MapLibre, Mapbox GL JS, OpenStreetMap data and tooling, QGIS, ArcGIS, Leaflet, OpenLayers or comparable platforms.&nbsp
Experience working with diverse spatial datasets - vector tiles, raster tiles, GeoJSON, shapefiles, point clouds or terrain data.&nbsp
Awareness of cartographic standards across regions and cultures, including sensitive topics such as disputed borders and local place names.&nbsp
Demonstrated ability to build visually compelling 2D and 3D map experiences - from thematic styling and terrain visualisation to street-level detail.&nbsp

Hands-on experience designing 3D map content such as buildings, terrain, landmarks and lane-level road geometry, in stylised or realistic form. You understand how LOD, lighting, materials and camera pitch affect legibility and performance.&nbsp
Experience with 3D data formats and pipelines such as glTF and 3D Tiles, and how 3D assets are prepared and optimised for real-time map rendering.&nbsp
Good understanding of real-time rendering concepts as they apply to maps: style layers, zoom interpolation, data-driven styling, symbol rendering and performance considerations.&nbsp
Evidence that AI has changed how you work. Be ready to show a real example, such as a map style, data visualisation or coded prototype built with AI, and tell us where it let you down.&nbsp
Sharp judgement of AI output. You can spot errors in generated work and know which decisions still need a designer's eye.&nbsp
Experience turning personal AI use into workflows the team shares, within the limits of confidential data and licensing.&nbsp
5+ years of professional experience in UX, product or cartographic design, with most of that time spent inside software product teams.&nbsp
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cartography, Geography, GIS, UX Design, Computer Science or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.&nbsp
Ability to build clear, concise prototypes and specification documentation that bridge design and engineering.&nbsp
Strong visual and graphic design fundamentals - typography, colour theory, hierarchy and layout.&nbsp
User-centric mindset with a collaborative, low-ego approach to problem-solving.&nbsp
High attention to detail and a real passion for the craft of map making.&nbsp
Experience with game engines or 3D content pipelines (Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender) and their application to geospatial visualisation.&nbsp

Familiarity with front-end languages and graphics APIs (JavaScript/TypeScript, WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL) or scripting for cartographic automation (Python, PostGIS, Overpass API). With AI, even basic coding skills go a long way.&nbsp
Experience with map data processing tools and pipelines: Tippecanoe, Tilemaker, osm2pgsql, Mapnik or similar.&nbsp
Understanding of the automotive, fleet management or logistics industries and their mapping requirements.&nbsp
Familiarity with emerging trends in spatial computing, AR navigation or digital twins.&nbsp
Experience contributing to design systems at scale.&nbsp

column5: Every investigation starts with data. As PM for the Integration team, you make sure analysts in law enforcement and defense have the data they need, when they need it. column3: This is a largely technical PM role with significant ownership over a platform and admin experience that are still taking shape. You decide what gets built and in what order, working closely with engineers and other product teams to turn provider APIs and data models into scalable integrations and features that support analysts’ investigations. You’ll read API documentation, map provider data to OIP’s data model and write clear, actionable specs that engineers can build from.&lt

column7: We add a source when it answers a question analysts can’t answer today, so you start from the analyst’s problem, not from a provider’s name. You talk regularly with analysts, admins and solutions engineers in law enforcement and defense, and with the upstream teams whose features bring integration requests. You decide which providers come next and what “done” means for each.&lt

Cover authentication, pagination, rate limits and quotas, incremental sync, deduplication, field mapping, and how failures surface. column7: That covers the contract between connectors and the platform, versioning, and how quickly a new provider goes from evaluation to production. Every connector should make the next one cheaper. That means creating a connection, managing credentials, scheduling, health and status, logs, quota usage and permissions. A source we can’t monitor isn’t delivered, so every live connection needs a health check and clear failure states.&lt

You collaborate with the Director of OSINT and the Data Acquisition Manager to evaluate vendors, raise licensing and terms-of-service questions before we build, and turn the legal framework (storage, retention, redistribution) into product requirements. Upstream, you work with the teams building user-facing features, such as graphs and maps, who bring integration requests from their intelligence domain. You help them find the analyst question behind each request and decide whether a shared connector can serve several of them. Downstream, you work with the foundation teams for ontology, machine learning and processing, so incoming data arrives in a shape they can use. You forecast the load of every high-volume source before it goes live.&lt

You own how analysts go from a first lead about a person to a reviewed set of linked online identities. That includes how results are presented and reviewed, and how to avoid paying for the same lookup twice.&lt
Track sync success rate, data freshness, time to onboard a provider, active connections, and time to resolve a failed connection.&lt

column1: full-stack-engineer-data-infrastructure-ai-berlin-440195,Agent F GmbH,"Full-Stack Engineer - Data, Infrastructure & AI",Berlin,False,1793952064,"About Agent FAgent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it.About the roleYou will be a full-stack engineer, shipping customer features across the interface, application services and database. Your particular strength will be the data and infrastructure that make those features dependable: how records are stored, how imports and background jobs run, and how information moves between Agent F and a customer’s other tools. You will help build and operate the whole product, with deeper ownership of this foundation.This is hands-on full-stack engineering. A typical piece of work could involve extending a data model, implementing an application service, connecting it to a screen, testing it against a real database and following the release into production. You will also investigate slow reports, failed imports and jobs that stop halfway through, then improve the system so it handles those situations reliably.That foundation also supports our AI work. As we add document extraction, connected customer knowledge and software that takes actions for customers, you will build the services and data access those features need. The immediate priority is dependable software that customers can use, with more capable automation developed around specific tasks.What you will build and improveApplication services and customer features. Build the logic and application programming interfaces (APIs) that connect records, business rules and screens. Take features through implementation, testing, release and production support.The database foundation. Design clear data models, enforce relationships and transaction boundaries, and improve slow queries. Manage schema changes through reviewed migrations, preserve financial history and keep each customer’s data isolated.Imports and integrations. Connect accounting tools, business systems and spreadsheets to a consistent model. Validate incoming records, handle changing source formats, and check that imported totals and reports agree with the source.Reliable background processing. Build scheduled jobs and workers that process work outside a user request. Handle retries without creating duplicates, resume interrupted runs, and make progress and failures visible to the team.Performance and recovery. Diagnose expensive queries, processing bottlenecks and partial failures. Test changes against real databases, plan for growing workloads, and build procedures to recover processing safely with the platform engineer.Practical AI automation. Add features such as extracting invoice fields or preparing an order from approved business data. Give models access through controlled services, check the result and require approval where needed. Develop connected customer knowledge when a feature needs those relationships, and measure whether it improves the result.For example, a large customer import stops halfway through and the same records arrive again on the next run. You would make processing resume safely, prevent duplicate records, verify the resulting totals and expose the job’s status in the product. You would also investigate whether database queries or worker capacity caused the failure and ship the necessary fix.What you bringYou have seven or more years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production applications and data systems. You have designed relational data models, built services and processing pipelines, and stayed responsible for them after release. You are comfortable delivering across the stack and using AI tools in your daily work.You can explain how you diagnosed a slow query, recovered a failed job or shipped a database change safely. You understand what happens when two requests arrive at once, a dependency becomes unavailable or a process restarts halfway through its work. You can follow a problem from a source record through the application to the result a customer sees.Core experienceFull-stack development with TypeScript, Node.js, React and PostgreSQL, or closely comparable technologies.Relational data modelling, SQL, query optimisation, indexes, transactions and reviewed database migrations.Application services and APIs, including permissions, validation and handling concurrent requests.Data imports, integrations and background jobs, including queues, safe retries and recovery from partial failures.Production debugging, service monitoring and performance work on systems used by real customers.Automated tests against real databases and other service dependencies.Practical use of AI in software, with an understanding of how to check outputs and control access to customer data.Daily use of AI coding agents, with direct responsibility for code review and verification.A computer science or computer engineering degree, or equivalent practical depth.Useful additional experienceFinancial or operational systems where correctness and traceability matter

You would address a concrete reliability or performance problem, such as a slow report, a fragile integration or a job that cannot recover cleanly after interruption.We would look for working features, faster and more predictable processing, fewer failed or manually repaired jobs, and useful tests and monitoring. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What you'll doThis role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.In this role, you will:Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. column3: You’ll work on the foundations that allow complex workloads to move from an abstract description into reliable execution across systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, OSMO, and future execution environments.&lt

A major part of the role is deciding where abstraction is useful — and where it creates more complexity. Rather than building another universal workflow engine, you’ll help establish clear contracts between our platform and the systems that execute work, while preserving native capabilities.&lt

You’ll operate across architecture and implementation: defining contracts, writing production software, validating assumptions against real workloads, and working closely with platform and infrastructure teams.&lt

Build conformance and validation mechanisms that make guarantees executable rather than dependent on documentation.&lt

column1: stage-construction-automatique-de-modeles-de-processus-hospitaliers-multi-flux-par-grands-modeles-de-langage-llm-albi-170098,Institut Mines-Télécom,Stage : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi- flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM),"Albi, Occitanie, France",False,1793935906,"Projet porté par : Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) Partenaires IMT impliqués :Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures,Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février):Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic LearningTitre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)Description du projet :L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences.Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens.Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète.Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux.Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain.Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ?Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S – CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. Cette synergie s’est prolongée par un stage M2 en 2025, financé par le Fonds d’amorçage Santé, dédié au prototypage d’une application mobile de localisation indoor/outdoor des patients. Une thèse INTERCARNOT a été lancé dans la continuité avec la validation des deux instituts Carnot (M.I.N.E.S et TSN) et va démarrer en Octobre 2026.Objectif du stageL'objectif est de concevoir et prototyper un pipeline dans lequel un même module de construction automatique de modèles par LLM est alimenté par deux sources :Branche A (rétrospective) : les logs SIH réels, normalisés en event logs, produisent des modèles as-is des processus observés
column2: Branche B (prospective) : dans la suite des travaux réalisés, les parcours prédits par LLM sont sérialisés au même format de traces (activité, timestamp, ressource) via un adaptateur, et produisent des modèles to-be des processus à venir.La comparaison des modèles as-is et to-be permet la détection d'écarts, l'anticipation des goulots d'étranglement et le support à la décision explicable, jusqu'à la simulation contrefactuelle (perturber les prédictions, reconstruire le modèle, observer l'impact).Profil recherchéFormation : M2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieur en informatique, science des données, IA ou génie industriel

column1: centrale-lyon-postdoctoral-researcher-position-deep-learning-for-functional-oxide-growth-video-to-spectrum-prediction-by-rheed-xrd-fusion-ecully-106543,CENTRALE LYON,CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion,"Ecully, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, France",False,1793935905,"PROJECT OVERVIEW We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE). The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon. A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools. Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth)

Green-Got est aussi lauréat de l'Impact 40 depuis 3 années consécutives.Depuis cinq ans, nous montrons où va l'argent. Nos membres ont sorti 300 millions d'euros des grandes banques. Notre mission est de définir de nouveaux standards pour le secteur financier, alignés avec la science, et non pas les intérêts des industries fossiles.Pourquoi ce recrutement ?Les banques traditionnelles ont des lobbyistes. Ils défendent leurs profits et les industries qu'elles financent. Les citoyens, eux, n'en ont jamais eu. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

Und jetzt suchen wir dich.💡 DEINE MISSIONvoize arbeitet direkt mit der Pflegesoftware unserer Kunden zusammen. Du arbeitest beratend auf Augenhöhe mit QM, Pflegedienstleitung, Einsatzplanung und Anwendungsbetreuung. social-media-manager-munich-270653,yfood Labs GmbH,Social Media Manager (m/w/d),Munich,False,1793878254,"DEINE MISSION

Lust, Ernährung neu zu denken? Bei yfood machen wir seit 2017 gutes Essen alltagstauglich – ausgewogen, praktisch und richtig lecker. Mit unseren Produkten haben wir eine eigene Kategorie geformt: Smart Food. In ganz Europa unterwegs, rasant wachsend und immer auf der Suche nach neuen Ideen. Wenn du Teil eines dynamischen Teams sein möchtest, das die Lebensmittelbranche revolutioniert, dann bist du bei yfood genau richtig.

Du postest eh schon jeden Tag. Mach daraus deinen Job.Du scrollst nicht nur – du weißt, warum ein Video durch die Decke geht und warum das nächste floppt. Genau dieses Gespür suchen wir. Der Großteil unserer Reichweite entsteht über Creator, nicht über uns selbst – und weil du selbst postest, sprichst du ihre Sprache und zeigst auf unseren eigenen Kanälen das Beste davon.Die Rolle ist global gedacht: Du denkst unsere Social-Strategie nicht nur für DACH, sondern sparrst dich dabei auch mit unseren internationalen Marketing Leads, zum Beispiel dem Head of Marketing in UK.
Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf zwei Jahre befristet.
Deine Aufgaben als Social Media Manager

Strategie, global gedacht: Du entwickelst unsere Social Media Strategie nicht im stillen Kämmerlein in München, sondern im Austausch mit unseren internationalen Marketing Leads. Du hinterfragst HQ-Vorgaben, wenn UK oder ein anderer Markt etwas anderes braucht, und sorgst dafür, dass Strategie und lokale Realität zusammenpassen.

TikTok ist dein zweites Zuhause: Du erkennst Trends, bevor sie durch sind, und weißt sofort, welche Formate zu yfood passen und welche nicht. Instagram und YouTube bespielst du mit, aber TikTok ist dein Hauptrevier.
Deine eigenen Kanäle, dein Anspruch: Du verantwortest unsere DACH-Kanäle und zeigst dort die stärksten Creator Videos, Produktlaunches und informativen Content. Qualität vor Quantität.

Du sprichst Creator-Sprache: Weil du selbst Content machst, schreibst du Briefings, die Raum für eigene Ideen lassen, und gibst Feedback, das Creator tatsächlich weiterbringt, statt sie nur zufriedenzustellen.
Du machst Markenmomente viral: Große Produktlaunches, außergewöhnliche Events und Creator Kampagnen bringst du auf Social und bist dabei auch in den Kommentaren mittendrin statt nur Beobachter.
Daten sind dein Vibe-Check: Du planst im Redaktionskalender, schaust auf Watch Time, Saves, Shares und Hook Rate und machst konsequent mehr von dem, was funktioniert.

Kein Soloprojekt: Du arbeitest eng mit Content & Comms, Influencer & Creator, Creative, Brand Activation, Performance und E-Commerce zusammen. Social ist bei uns nicht einfach nur ein Kanal, sondern das Betriebssystem.
Deine Qualifikationen als Social Media Manager
Du bist selbst Social: Aktiv auf TikTok, idealerweise mit eigenem Content – zeig uns gern deinen Kanal. Instagram und YouTube kennst du ebenfalls aus dem Effeff.
2+ Jahre Erfahrung im Social Media Marketing – ob Brand, Agentur, Start-up oder als Creator. Food, FMCG oder Lifestyle sind ein Plus, kein Muss.
Plattform-Fluency: Sounds, Duett/Stitch, Green Screen, Reels, Carousels, Shorts – du weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, was wo funktioniert und warum.
Creator-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Creator ticken, und formulierst Briefings und Feedback so, dass sie auch ankommen.
Analyse mit Attitüde: Watch Time, Saves, Shares, Hook-Rate sind für dich Steuerrad, kein Selbstzweck.
Wir sind ein bisschen anders – und genau das macht uns aus
Leidenschaft – Wir brennen für das, was wir tun. Voller Energie, voller Optimismus, immer hungrig nach Neuem.
Verantwortung – Heißt für uns: Füreinander einstehen, Verantwortung übernehmen und alles geben, wenn’s drauf ankommt.
Professionalität – Wir nehmen unsere Arbeit ernst – uns selbst aber nicht zu sehr. Wir sind offen, direkt und immer auf Augenhöhe. Kein Bullshit, kein Ego. Nur Team.
Innovation – Wir denken lieber „Warum eigentlich nicht?“ statt „Das war schon immer so.“ Wir lieben neue Ideen, unkonventionelle Wege – und bleiben nie stehen.

Wir fördern Chancengleichheit und schätzen Vielfalt. Wir verpflichten uns, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitende zu schaffen.

yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.
Agilität ist uns wichtig. Daher arbeiten wir in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell und bieten dir die Möglichkeit mit Workation aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.
Urlaub ist wichtig. Daher erhältst du bei uns 30 Tage bezahlten Urlaub im Jahr.

yfood hält dich fit. Mit einer subventionierten Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM-Wellpass kannst du dir für nur 29€ im Monat Gutes tun. Dazu bieten wir im Rahmen unseres Gesundheitsmanagements & Healthy@yfood Workshops und Aktionen (z.B. Yoga, Breathwork, Soccer, Pickleball) an.

Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. head-of-product-sap-berlin-422403,Qorelo,Head of Product – SAP (m/f/d),Berlin,False,1793871625,"Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

We are looking for our first Head of Product. You own what Qorelo builds and why, and you build the product function around it. You lead our solution architects, the people who carry our SAP domain depth, you work hand in hand with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you report directly to the C-level.

This is a leadership role at an early-stage company, which means two things at once. You set product strategy and make the big roadmap calls together with the founders, and you still write the spec, sit in the customer workshop and draw the cut line when it matters. Your decisions show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.

• Product strategy. Where Qorelo goes across the transformation lifecycle, which problems we solve first and which we deliberately leave to others. You turn that into a roadmap the whole company understands.
• The roadmap and the calls behind it. You prioritise with evidence from customers, Proofs of Value and the market, and you can defend every call to the founders, to sales and to engineering.
• The product team. You lead our two solution architects today and grow the product team as we scale: hiring, coaching and setting the bar.

• Discovery with real users. Consultants, SAP leads and transformation teams use Qorelo inside live programmes. You and your team sit with them, see where the product wins and where it falls short, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes.
• Product in the sales cycle. You join key customer and partner conversations, shape Proofs of Value with sales, and make sure what we promise matches what we ship.

• The bridge between SAP and AI. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost, and together with our solution architects you make sure what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct.
• Shipping and outcomes. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines and success metrics. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed.

What you need• 6+ years of professional experience, with deep hands-on SAP experience: S/4HANA transformation, fit-to-standard, and module-level depth in at least one core area such as FI/CO, SD, MM or PP. Whether you come from SAP consulting, solution architecture or product at an SAP ecosystem software company, all of it counts.• 4+ years in product: you've owned a B2B product and its roadmap end to end, prioritised with engineering and shipped to enterprise users. Title doesn't matter, ownership does.• Experience leading people: you have led product managers, solution architects or consultants, and you want to keep building a team.• A command of the SAP transformation lifecycle and SAP Activate deep enough to be credible with CIOs, Heads of SAP and senior consultants at enterprise clients.• Strong AI curiosity: you've actually built or worked hands-on with LLM tooling and formed opinions about where it breaks.• Comfort in an early-stage environment: ambiguity, speed, hands-on work alongside strategy.• Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base, but not expected.You might be a fit if• You've sat inside an S/4HANA programme and thought ""half of this should be software"", and you can name which half.• Consultants trust you on module questions and engineers trust you to write a clear spec.You've taken a product from its first enterprise customers to something repeatable, and you know what you would do differently next time.• You know the SAP tool landscape, from Cloud ALM to Signavio and LeanIX, and where the gaps between them are.• You want your product decisions to run inside DAX 40 landscapes within weeks, not sit in a committee for quarters.What we offer
• Real ownership. A seat at the leadership table, meaningful equity and a direct hand in the company's direction. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.
• Competitive salary, benchmarked for product leadership in Berlin.
• The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. Your roadmap runs at the core of companies most product leaders only read about.
• The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to the founders, engineers and architects who build what you define.
• 25 days paid vacation plus German public holidays.
• Company offsites with the whole team.
• An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg. This role works from the office, because product decisions here happen in the room with the architects and engineers.
• Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.

Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.Deine AufgabenOnboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.Das bringst du mitRelevante Erfahrung: Du hast 8+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann. 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen. Wen wir suchenUm bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten. Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit. Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. column1: By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.Location
While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.
This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a cross-functional team in our Product Engineering organization. Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, find out what they need, set their own goals and choose how to solve the problems that matter most.

AI is already part of how we build software at Lokalise, and it's changing what great engineering leadership looks like. We're looking for a leader who stays close to the work and understands how AI is changing speed, quality and engineers' day-to-day experience. You'll keep your teams focused on outcomes that matter to our customers and our business, not just on how much gets shipped.

For this role, you'll lead our Editing Experience team. The team owns the tools linguists and reviewers use every day to translate, review and approve content at scale: the translation editor, the review and approval workflow, content management tools and the developer utilities that support them. Together with your Product Manager and Designer, you'll own the team's strategy and delivery end to end.
Lead, coach and develop your teams of Software Engineers. You'll support their career growth, run performance evaluations, contribute to compensation planning and hire engineers who raise the bar.

Stay technically close to the work without becoming a bottleneck. You'll review key designs and pull requests, pair with engineers on tricky problems and take on contributions outside the critical path (such as tooling, prototypes or small fixes). This keeps you in touch with the codebase and your teams' daily reality while they own delivery.

Partner with Product Managers and Designers (the Product Triad) to understand our customers deeply and take part in discovery. You'll make sure your teams work on the right problems, putting outcomes ahead of outputs.

Connect engineering decisions to business impact. Understand how your domain contributes to customer value, retention and revenue, and use that to guide trade-offs on scope, investment and technical debt.

Own your teams' flow of work from start to finish. Track and act on delivery and quality signals (such as cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rate and recovery time), clear bottlenecks across planning, review, testing and release, and keep cognitive load sustainable.

Lead your teams' move to AI-native engineering across the SDLC. Embed AI tools and agentic workflows, measure their real effect on speed, quality and how engineers experience their work, and adapt team practices so faster delivery never costs reliability or maintainability.
Champion operational excellence. Drive reliability and quality practices, own the health of the services your teams run and step in as Incident Commander when needed.
Own your teams' delivery: set quarterly plans, track progress against the product roadmap and help shape department-wide planning and strategy.
3+ years of recent experience as an Engineering Manager leading software engineering teams, ideally in SaaS product companies.
A strong software engineering background, and you're still hands-on today. You can review code and designs credibly, dig into technical issues and contribute to architecture decisions.
Proven people leadership: hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management and helping engineers grow into their next role.
A strong product engineering mindset. You've partnered with Product and Design on discovery, worked directly with customers and measured success by customer and business outcomes rather than output.
Business acumen. You understand the commercial context, can explain trade-offs in terms of impact and communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels.

Experience using engineering metrics and flow practices (such as DORA metrics, cycle time or WIP limits) to find bottlenecks and improve delivery, quality and team health, without turning metrics into targets.

Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and agentic tools, both in your own work and across a team. You have a clear view of how AI changes delivery speed, code quality, review practices and cognitive load.
Experience planning and delivering complex initiatives across several teams predictably, including managing dependencies, risks and incidents.

None of these are required, and we're happy to support you as you learn them on the job.
Experience in the localization industry or with translation workflows.
Experience leading engineering teams at a product company during a scale-up phase.
Experience shipping AI-powered product features, such as LLM-based features, to customers.
Experience managing fully remote, distributed teams.
Familiarity with developer experience or productivity frameworks, such as SPACE or DevEx.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.About the role:

Samsara's UK Enterprise business is one of our fastest-growing segments globally. We've scaled rapidly over the past several years — consistently outpacing the broader business — and we're now at an inflection point where we need to pair that momentum with operational rigour to sustain growth at scale.&nbsp

This Regional Sales Director role is central to that next chapter. You'll lead a team of six Senior Enterprise Account Executives and Client Directors selling into some of the UK's largest and most complex organisations, spanning transportation, logistics, infrastructure, utilities, and field services.&nbsp

The team is performing — but we want to turn strong results into a repeatable, scalable engine. That means bringing structure, coaching discipline, and a proven enterprise playbook without losing the pace and builder energy that got us here.
Own the performance, development, and day-to-day leadership of a team of Senior Enterprise AEs, driving net new logo acquisition and expansion across a defined set of strategic UK accounts
Coach your team through complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles where average contract values regularly reach seven figures over multi-year terms
Build and run a structured operating rhythm - pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecasting discipline - while getting close enough to the detail to add value at the deal level
Develop your reps' ability to access economic buyers, build multi-threaded relationships, and position Samsara's expanding product portfolio against a customer's most critical business priorities
Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large UK enterprises - this isn't a role where you sit above the deals
Build the commercial muscles - cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping - that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the UK's largest accounts

Partner closely with the AVP of Strategic and Enterprise Sales UK, your peer RSDs, and cross-functional teams including Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure your team has the support it needs to win

Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team
Proven experience as a frontline or second-line sales leader in B2B enterprise technology, with direct responsibility for team quota attainment
Track record of coaching Account Executives through complex, multi-quarter sales cycles with average deal sizes of £250K+ ACV, but with experience of seven figure ACV deals&nbsp
Experience selling into large, multi-stakeholder organisations where procurement, legal, and multiple business units are involved in the buying decision
Demonstrated ability to build and enforce a structured sales operating cadence — pipeline generation, deal qualification, forecasting accuracy, and stage progression
Strong commercial instinct for multi-product or platform selling, where the value proposition spans multiple use cases and buyer personas

Experience at a high-growth technology company that was scaling its enterprise go-to-market in the UK or EMEA — ideally where you helped build or refine the playbook rather than inheriting an established one
A coaching-first leadership style with a track record of developing AEs from good to exceptional, not just managing top performers
Experience managing forecast accuracy as a discipline, not just an output — particularly in an environment where leadership investment decisions depend on the reliability of your calls
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you're expected to build process while delivering results
A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity — you can set a multi-year account strategy and also jump into a deal review and tell a rep exactly where their qualification is weak

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
