column9: : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. INJECT résoudra ce problème en s'appuyant sur une nouvelle méthode scientifique révolutionnaire qui empêchera la sismicité induite par l'homme et maximisera la production et le stockage d'énergie à partir de ressources naturelles renouvelables et durables.La méthodologie interdisciplinaire d'INJECT repose sur un programme scientifique astucieux qui place la théorie du contrôle et les mathématiques au cœur de ce nouveau défi. Sur la base de développements théoriques de pointe, des contrôleurs et des observateurs robustes seront conçus pour ajuster de manière optimale les taux d'injection de fluides, prévenir les événements sismiques induits sur de vastes régions et optimiser la production et le stockage d'énergie. Les méthodes théoriques innovantes d'INJECT seront testées en profondeur à l'aide de modèles numériques de haute fidélité qui tiendront compte de la dynamique poro-élasto, du frottement de Coulomb, de la multiphysique et de la modélisation d'ordre réduit. Le plan expérimental s'appuiera sur des démonstrateurs et des essais hybrides laboratoire-ordinateur pour tester la théorie. Pour plus d'informations : https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771 ----- class=""Default"" style=""text-align:justify
column11: :Le thème de recherche se concentre sur le développement d'un dispositif innovant conçu pour reproduire et contrôler la sismicité induite dans un cadre de laboratoire.&nbsp
column12: En tant que chercheur doctorant, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conception et la construction de démonstrateurs innovants adaptés à la méthodologie d'INJECT. Cette opportunité englobe l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement, c'est-à-dire de la conceptualisation des idées à l'assemblage et au test rigoureux de prototypes de laboratoire avancés pour des expériences géomécaniques. Vous intégrerez la conception mécanique, l'ingénierie des matériaux, la mise en œuvre des capteurs et des contrôleurs, l'analyse des données et la modélisation numérique. L'objectif ultime est de reproduire et de contrôler les instabilités sismiques causées par des injections de fluides dans un environnement de laboratoire contrôlé, ouvrant ainsi la voie à des applications dans le monde réel.Missions / Activité annexe&nbsp

column2: it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.How we workWe're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 2, that looks like this: What you'll be doingTaking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.What you'll need to have doneBuilt and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them. You’re unlikely to thrive here ifYou prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. CompensationAt hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. column1: ai-for-hardware-engineer-frontier-tech-paris-362256,Hexa,"AI-for-Hardware Engineer, Frontier Tech",Paris,False,1793752814,"About HexaHexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign.Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.The hardware vertical at Hexa: Frontier TechFrontier Tech is Hexa’s studio focused on physical tech, led by Guerric de Crombrugghe.We build companies that move atoms: real machines, deployed in the field, often for defense, energy, space and critical infrastructure. A few examples of what is on the bench today include containerized atmospheric water generators, expendable turbojets, and ship-borne satellite ground stations.Our edge is velocity. We go from idea to working hardware with small teams and lean budgets, against legacy players with hundreds of engineers and decade-long programs. AI is now the biggest lever we have to widen that gap, today by speeding up how we build, and tomorrow by shaping what kind of companies we build.Why this role, why nowAI for hardware is moving faster than any team can track. Our internal map now tracks close to 200 tools, from text-to-CAD, AI-native electronics and physics surrogates to manufacturing, test data, procurement and the MCP connectors that let agents drive CAD and EDA tools directly.Most of these tools will not matter. A handful will cut weeks off our programs. We need someone whose job is to find those, prove them on our real parts, and put them in the hands of our founders before our competitors do.The missionWe’re looking for an industrial hardware engineer who is 100% AI-pilled, with a dual objective:Adopt AI inside our startups. Make every Frontier Tech venture the fastest-moving hardware team in its category, using the best AI tools available today.Build companies that grow with AI. Design products and business models that are both AI-enabled (they get better with every new generation of models) and AI-enablers (they feed AI with the data, compute, energy or infrastructure it needs), and run the companies themselves on AI from day one. The goal is a positive feedback loop: the more AI grows, the more our companies grow.Adoption is the immediate focus. The role splits into two:80%: deploy AI inside our venturesHands-on, embedded in the teams, measured by weeks saved.Map the bottlenecks. Sit with each venture and map its engineering workflow, from requirements to design, simulation, electronics, firmware, test, manufacturing and documentation. Find the steps that cost the most weeks.Do the engineering. You are part of the team, not an advisor. You will run the CAD, set up the simulations, push the PCB, write the firmware agent, build the digital twin, produce the documentation, build the tools that automate technical pre-sales material that wins a contract. You ship parts and files, not slides.Run the shared AI infrastructure. Set up and maintain the agents, repos and connectors between tools (CAD, EDA, simulation, data), with a common setup across ventures, so founders spend their time engineering rather than configuring.Make it stick. Start with hands-on workshops on each team’s real problems, then train founders and engineers, write the playbooks, and track real adoption so tools are used every day rather than demoed once.20%: studio radar and partnershipsKeep the map alive. Track the AI-for-hardware landscape and what frontier labs ship, and maintain our living map of tools, maturity and pricing.See beyond the hype. Our founders want evidence, not promises. Benchmark tools on our own parts and problems, not on vendor demos, and tell the studio plainly where the value is and where it is not.Close partnerships. Negotiate studio-wide deals with key players (early access, design-partner status, credits, preferential pricing) so every Hexa hardware venture starts with better conditions than it could get alone.Build the default stack. Turn what works into a reusable AI toolkit that every new Frontier Tech venture gets on day one.Design AI-native companies. Work with founders from day one on where AI sits in the product, how the business model captures value as models improve, which data to capture and own, and which workflows run on agents so the team scales without headcount growing in step with revenue.Who we’re looking forAn industrial hardware engineer. 3 to 7 years designing, building and testing physical products in aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, industrial equipment or a hardware startup. You have taken parts from CAD to the shop floor and know tolerancing, DFM, test campaigns and suppliers.100% AI-pilled. You use AI agents every day, you have built your own automations, and you have already tried text-to-CAD, AI simulation or AI electronics tools on real work. You switch setups as soon as something better ships, and you have opinions on how a hardware company should be built when much of its engineering is done by agents.A skeptical builder. You judge tools by measured time saved, not by launch videos. You are as happy killing a tool as adopting one.High agency and fast. You figure it out and ship without waiting to be told how. You are comfortable jumping between projects in the same week.Commercial sense and pedagogy. Comfortable in front of founders, engineers and vendors, able to run a workshop that turns skeptics into users, and to negotiate a partnership that actually benefits our ventures.Languages and location. Working in English, based in Paris or Brussels, with regular days physically with the founding teams.Recruitment processFirst call with Laure, Talent Partner at HexaInterview with Guerric: mutual introduction, deep dive into the role and how we work.Case study: a real engineering problem from one of our ventures with Tanguy, Hexa's CTO. Propose an AI-augmented workflow and run it as a short hands-on workshop with the founders, with at least one tool working live Cultural fit interview with Matthieu (CEO)Coffee with team members &amp

column2: :École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables.Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis).&nbsp
column4: :Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne.Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis.Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales.L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie.Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables.Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables&nbsp

column8: :Les dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables constituent une approche prometteuse pour le développement de systèmes électroniques temporaires, notamment dans le domaine biomédical. Ces dispositifs sont conçus pour assurer une fonction spécifique avant de se dégrader progressivement, ce qui nécessite le développement de matériaux adaptés et de solutions de stockage de l’énergie compatibles avec cette approche.Dans ce contexte, ce stage porte sur le développement de matériaux d’électrode pour des batteries destinées aux dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables (resorbtronics). L’objectif est de préparer et de mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode, puis d’étudier leurs propriétés électrochimiques afin de mieux comprendre leur comportement et d’évaluer leur potentiel pour le stockage de l’énergie.Le/la stagiaire participera à la préparation des matériaux, à la réalisation des expériences électrochimiques ainsi qu’à l’analyse et à l’interprétation des résultats. Ce travail contribuera à identifier les paramètres influençant les performances des électrodes et à orienter leur optimisation. 🎯&nbsp

column1: brand-director-paris-308346,Amo,Brand Director,Paris,False,1793731235,"We're a group of friends building apps for friends, and we think friendship deserves a better place online. column1: Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.
Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.&nbsp
Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.
The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume.&nbsp
Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.

A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.

A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.

Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our&nbsp

We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. We're looking for someone who combines strong people leadership with technical depth, and who enjoys building high-performing teams, improving how engineers work, and creating the foundations for sustainable growth.You'll initially lead a multidisciplinary team of up to ten engineers across backend, frontend, and data, taking ownership of their development, performance, and delivery. Working closely with Product Managers and engineering leadership, you'll help translate business priorities into achievable engineering objectives, ensuring teams have the clarity, support, and processes they need to deliver great work.This is an opportunity to have a real impact on how our engineering organization evolves. As we scale toward 25 engineers, you'll help shape our squad structure, establish effective ways of working, and build an environment where engineers can grow and do their best work. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience ""terrain"".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.Dans le futur, tu auras Ta connaissance de la comptabilité et des réalités quotidiennes des cabinets te permettra de comprendre rapidement leurs problématiques, de leur apporter des réponses adaptées et de les aider à tirer pleinement parti de Pennylane.🌍 Pennylane, c'est quoi ?Pennylane est une fintech française parmi les plus dynamiques du pays, actuellement en pleine expansion à l'échelle européenne.En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoia, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leurs débuts👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1 000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs qui recommanderaient Pennylane à leurs proches🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail vraiment flexible🚀 Déjà plus de 900 000 TPE/PME et plus de 6 000 cabinets d'expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !🎯 Ton rôleTu rejoins l’équipe Support applicatif et technique en tant qu’expert métier et plateforme.Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié des dirigeants, des comptables internalisés et des cabinets d’expertise-comptable qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur comptabilité et leurs finances.Au quotidien, tu analyses leurs problématiques, les accompagnes dans la résolution de leurs demandes et les aides à tirer pleinement parti de la plateforme. Tu contribues également à l’amélioration du produit en faisant remonter des retours structurés aux équipes internes.📋 Tes missionsSupport et résolution de problèmesRéceptionner, qualifier et analyser les demandes des utilisateursComprendre leur problématique et leur contexte métierApporter des réponses claires, pédagogiques et adaptéesAssurer le suivi des tickets jusqu’à leur résolution complèteEscalader les sujets complexes aux équipes techniques ou produitGarantir un haut niveau de qualité de serviceAccompagnement des migrationsAider les comptables en entreprise et en cabinet à intégrer leurs données dans PennylaneComprendre les enjeux liés à la migration depuis un autre logiciel comptableIdentifier les éventuelles difficultés et coordonner leur résolutionParticiper à l’amélioration des processus et de la documentation associésAmélioration continue et partage d’expertiseCréer et mettre à jour les supports d’aide destinés aux utilisateursIdentifier les questions récurrentes et favoriser l’autonomie des clientsPartager tes connaissances comptables avec l’équipeFaire remonter les irritants et les besoins aux équipes produitProposer des améliorations sur les process et les outils internes🚀 Tes premiers mois chez Pennylane Tu te formes sur le produit et les process de l’équipeTu découvres l’entreprise, sa vision et ses différents départementsTu apprends à identifier les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacementTu commences à traiter des demandes liées à la comptabilitéTu gagnes en autonomie et prends en charge tes demandes de bout en boutTu traites des problématiques de plus en plus complexesTu contribues aux supports d’aide et au partage de connaissancesTu deviens un relais de la voix du client auprès des équipes produitEt ensuiteTu deviens progressivement un expert produit et métier, capable d’identifier les axes d’amélioration et de porter des projets.
